snippet.title: Will Jump Trailer ENG
snippet.description:
Discover “Will Jump”, a captivating platform game that plunges you into a retro universe full of challenges. 
Play as Will, an intrepid locksmith and hero who comes running with his keys. 
Get ready to overcome 23 thrilling levels spread over 6 unique biomes. 
With its “die & retry” gameplay, every attempt will bring you closer to victory or a nervous breakdown. 
Dive into this pixelated adventure and take on the challenge of conquering every platform!
